title: Field boundaries for the Canadian Prairies, derived from Sentinel-2
description:
Field boundaries for Alberta, Saskatchewan and Manitoba, segmented from Sentinel-2 imagery of
2021-2024 with the Segment Anything Model by the University of Saskatchewan. The boundaries are
derived, not declared: no farmer or authority drew them. Seasonal RGB composites were segmented
without training data, the polygons cleaned and smoothed, and only those of at least 2 ha that
mostly lie on cropland (AAFC Annual Crop Inventory and ESA WorldCover) were kept. One file per
rural municipality (RM).

This collection holds 1 edition (2024), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2024). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:4326). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/ca_prairies/AGENTS.md).

Boundaries are inferred: a model derived them from satellite imagery, so they are an estimate of where fields are, not a record of what anyone declared or surveyed.

table:columns.name: metrics:perimeter
table:columns.description: Perimeter of the field, in meters (m). Must be > 0 and <= 125,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin:subdivision_code
table:columns.description: ISO 3166-2 code for the principal subdivision (e.g., province or state, aka admin1) of a country that contains the field. Only the second part of the ISO 3166-2 code is stored. ([spec](https://github.com/vecorel/administrative-division-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_local_code
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `RM_number`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: admin_local_name
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `RM_name`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Canada, Prairies — latest edition (2024) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2024/ca_prairies-2024.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 10, 20, 50 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
